method: All positive inventory-closed bracketing groups, each target intervened separately. Actual full prefix receipts and grouped leg cashflow must match. Omit target unless subsequent sender nonce requires explicitly labeled zero-value nonce-only replacement (same fees, 21000 gas). Remaining calldata and block environment unchanged. Evaluate combined leg cashflows, NOT mark-to-market residual pool positions, beneficial ownership or optimized alternatives. Overlapping interventions cannot be added.
